figures.title: Figure 5a-f
figures.summary: Original Figure 5a-f. Panel a: TAA–EDT forward/reverse scans. Panel b: the three device families. Panel c: seven TAA–EDT devices. Panel d: TAA–EDT and TAA–MPA EQE with a solar reference. Panels e–f: three-family decay and lifetime comparisons. EQE interpretation remains unresolved: p.7 describes an excitonic-peak interpretation reaching up to 82%, while panel d places the high response in the visible region and a smaller feature near 1000 nm. No 82% value is assigned to that near-IR feature and no numerical height is digitized.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
